identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current iRobot US product pages. Roomba Combo Essential, Roomba 694, Roomba i3+ and Roomba Combo j5+ are four separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no company focus was added; the existing iRobot company focus stays unchanged. The reviewed Combo Essential page publishes a 274.99 USD price, so the catalog 275 USD price and small size label are replaced; the Roomba 694 and i3+ pages show no price, so the catalog ~275 and ~599 USD prices are cleared. The Combo j5+ page publishes 729.99 USD, so the catalog ~599 USD price is replaced. The catalog 3.2 kg, 3.07 kg and 3.4 kg masses are replaced by reviewed masses where published and cleared where only a partial dimension pair is published; the catalog 34 x 34 cm and 34 x 34 x 9.2 cm dimensions are replaced or cleared; and the catalog 90 min, 75 min and 2 hour battery labels and 120 min, 90 min and 75 min runtime values are replaced or cleared. Only the Combo Essential page publishes a runtime in minutes.

fields.description: The iRobot Roomba Combo Essential is a 2-in-1 vacuum and mop robot measuring 12.99 x 12.99 x 3.15 in and weighing 6.17 lb. It offers three suction levels and three water levels, spot cleaning for up to 2 minutes, app and voice control and up to 120 minutes of cleaning on a single charge, after which it returns to its charging dock. companyFocus.name: Ecovacs
companyFocus.role: Consumer and commercial cleaning and lawn-robot developer
highlights: Consumer range includes DEEBOT floor cleaning, WINBOT glass cleaning and GOAT lawn mowing; ECOVACSCommercial separately describes K1 VAC andM1/M1 3D commercial cleaning platforms.

GOAT A3000 LiDAR PRO, A2000 LiDAR PRO andO1000 LiDAR PRO are separately named hardware models with TruEdge trimming, HoloScope 360 dual-LiDAR and AIVI 3D claims. Garage/blade accessory bundles are not extra robot models.
Commercial tables retain task-specific endurance, roller width, theoretical area rate and clean/recovery tank capacity. K1 charging and area-rate disagreements are exposed rather than averaged.
WINBOT robot mass, portable station battery duration, power-off protection, water tank and area-time rate are separate quantities. Exterior-window use retains the manual tether/weather conditions.
US product prices and stock are dated regional observations. OriginalA3000 out-of-stock status is not inherited byPRO models; model-selector/accessory prices are not substituted for the main product.
Navigation, obstacle avoidance, edge cutting and productivity remain manufacturer claims; no independently verified exclusivity, zero-risk guarantee or complete historical portfolio asserted.
The current US DEEBOT range adds T80 OMNI, X8 PRO OMNI, X9 PRO OMNI and X11 OmniCyclone with OZMO roller mopping, TruEdge edge cleaning and OMNI stations.
The reviewed DEEBOT pages publish 6,400 mAh batteries, 18,000 to 19,500 Pa suction, 4 h 37 min or less charging and 297 min or less silent sweep runtime.
